rules.structure: Two sleeves, two rubrics. Core (target 70%) holds the names that carry the book through a downturn: durability 4 or 5, scored on the 3-5 year rubric, sized 4-6%, never traded on a Zacks Rank move. Growth (target 30%) holds the names that can run: durability 2-3 allowed, scored on the original rubric with estimate momentum, sized 2-3% and never 4%, hard sell triggers acted on the week they fire. 24-25 names total.
rules.coreScoring: Quality and Durability ~28% each, Growth and Valuation ~22% each, on the same 25-point scale (18 is the bar). Growth blends 3-year trailing EPS CAGR with 2-year forward consensus, minus one if the trailing leg is negative, capped at 4 with no 3-year history. Estimate momentum is not scored; a Zacks Rank of 4-5 is a gate flag that sends the name to the firm research check, not a point deduction.
rules.growthScoring: Five factors 1-5 each, 18 of 25 is the bar; entries at 17-18 start at 2%. Quality: ROIC (ROE for financials), operating margin, net debt/EBITDA, FCF conversion. Growth: long-term EPS growth, bumped by forward revenue growth over 20%. Valuation: PEG, penalized above 15x sales. Estimate momentum: Zacks Rank and 4-week change in F1/F2 consensus. Durability: judgment, reason written next to it.
rules.construction: Tech capped at 9 names, wafer-fab equipment at 3, memory at 1. AI-capex beneficiaries capped at 50% of the whole book, not the sleeve, so the growth sleeve has to hold FIX/GEV/CAT-type names alongside the chips. Scores pick the names; correlation sets the weights.
rules.sizing: Core: Tier A (core score 20+) 5-6%, Tier B (18-20) 4%. Growth: 3% standard, 2% for 17-18 entries, never 4%. Sleeve trigger: if the growth sleeve as a group is down more than 20% from its high-water mark, trim it toward 25% and let the core absorb the weight until the theme turns.
rules.cadence: Re-score weekly (Sunday script), each sleeve on its own rubric. Hard triggers act the week they fire: growth-sleeve Zacks Rank 4-5, F2 consensus cut more than 5% in 60 days, the stated sell trigger, or the sleeve drawdown trigger. Core Zacks Rank 4-5 is a flag for the firm research check, not a sale. Weights, swaps and tiers batch to the monthly review. Theses re-read quarterly with hyperscaler capex guidance (MSFT, GOOG, AMZN, META) as the demand signal for the AI-capex names.
rules.data: Zacks Rank and style data come from chat reviews and are stored here; the Sunday script refreshes FMP prices, fundamentals and estimates and recomputes the scores. Every name still goes through the firm research before any client sees it. Information for advisor use, not a recommendation.
